steps.name: Setup — dynamically like an unliked agent to establish this case's precondition (declared improvisation — see this file's module docstring / AFS § Preconditions)
Step 2 — Locate an agent card currently liked by the user
Step 3 — Click the heart icon on agent (id=31) to unlike it
Step 4 — Verify the heart icon changes to an unfilled/inactive state
Step 5 — Verify the like count decrements by 1

Side-channel check — known defect #1215 console error on the unlike click (checked here, after steps 4-5's own waits, so the async dispatch that triggers it has definitely already landed — same ordering as ELITEA-2354/2358)
Step 6 — Refresh the page and verify the updated like count and unliked state persist
